Quick Takeaways


Five takeaways marketers need to know about Connected TV.


1. 1


Connected TV combines television reach with digital targeting precision.


2. 2


Technical compliance prevents delays before campaigns reach living rooms.


3. 3


Strong creative focuses on one memorable message and action.


4. 4


Ads should feel native to premium big-screen viewing environments.


5. 5


Performance improves when marketers measure outcomes and refresh creative.


Connected TV brings television’s reach and impact together with the precision of digital. And if you’re reading this right now, you’ve already decided to take advantage of this innovative channel. That puts you several steps in front of the competition.


But every streaming service has its own creative requirements. An out-of-spec file can delay or derail a campaign before it ever reaches the biggest screen in the house, which is kind of the whole point of this exercise.


This guide focuses on the Connected TV ad specs marketers need most: aspect ratio, maximum file size, video length, frame rate, bitrate, and file type. Get these right, and your campaign has a shot to make an impact.


---


## MNTN **Performance TV**


MNTN Performance TV delivers the flexibility and control you need to maximize ROAS while reaching targeted audiences across premium streaming inventory. With MNTN, you’ll gain access to familiar performance marketing tools you already rely on from other digital channels, making the switch to CTV feel completely seamless. All you need is a video and a goal, and you’re good to go.


### **Performance TV Ad Formats and Video Specs**


Aspect ratio


16:9 (1920 × 1080 or higher)


Max file size


4 GB


Video length


Exactly 15 or 30 seconds


Frame rate


23.98, 25, or 29.97 FPS; must remain constant and match the source footage’s native frame rate


Bitrate


15–30 Mbps


File type


.mp4 or .mov


### **Creative Tips for Performance TV Advertising**


Once the technical specs are locked in, creative becomes the next performance lever.


Use a clear, confident voiceover that carries your brand’s message even when viewers look away. Hook the audience early, and keep the story focused on one core idea. Don’t create a collage of takeaways otherwise, they’ll all fall flat. Refresh creative regularly to prevent fatigue. Keep your logo and URL visible throughout the entire spot, and close with a clear CTA and website URL. If you don’t make the next steps clear and obvious, most viewers won’t take the next step.


***Important clarification for MNTN advertisers** : This guide covers standard video requirements. Streaming-native formats such as pause ads and home-screen placements may have separate specifications. For the final word on your campaign, follow the requirements in your campaign builder or the[MNTN Help Center](https://help.mountain.com/en/articles/6633854-understand-video-file-requirements) . The rest of the specifications listed in this guide are specific to each service if you choose to go direct.*

## **Netflix**


Netflix made a major shift when it launched its lower-cost ad-supported plan in November 2022. While Netflix is rarely late to the party, it finally opened its premium streaming inventory to marketers after more than 15 years of ad-free service.


### **Netflix **Ad Formats & Video Specs****


Aspect ratio


16:9 full frame (1280 × 720 or 1920 × 1080, with no letterboxing or pillarboxing)


Max file size


Not publicly specified; confirm the upload limit with Netflix Ads Manager, your DSP, or your trafficking partner


Video length


10–75 seconds for Netflix’s standard programmatic video format; common hosted-creative cuts are 10, 15, 20, 30, and 60 seconds, with availability varying by market and buying path


Frame rate


23.976, 24, 25, 29.97, or 30 FPS; constant frame rate and progressive scan


Bitrate


H.264 must exceed 8 Mbps at 720p or 12 Mbps at 1080p; MOV deliverables must exceed 42 Mbps at 720p or 80 Mbps at 1080p


File type


.mp4 or .mov; Apple ProRes is preferred, while H.264 is accepted


*See the full list of[Netflix Creative Specifications](https://advertising.netflix.com/en-us/creative-specs) .*


### **Creative Tips for Netflix Advertising**


On Netflix, make your spot feel at home alongside premium programming. Open with a strong visual hook and build intrigue quickly. Make the brand part of the story rather than an interruption to it. Polished visuals, clean sound, and one focused message will land better than an overloaded hard sell.


Because available formats and interactive features can differ by buying path, confirm support before building the concept around a QR code, pause-ad interaction, or other platform-specific execution.

## **Roku**


Roku sits at the center of the streaming experience in millions of living rooms globally. Between Roku devices, smart TVs with built-in Roku OS, and free, ad-supported streaming through The Roku Channel, marketers have several great ways to reach this loyal streaming audience.


### **Roku **Ad Formats & Video Specs****


Aspect ratio


16:9


Max file size


1 GB


Video length


6–92 seconds


Frame rate


23.98, 25.00, or 29.97 FPS


Bitrate


6 Mbps minimum


File type


.mov or .mp4 using AVC/H.264 or Apple ProRes 422 HQ


*See the full list of[Roku Creative Specifications](https://help.ads.roku.com/en/articles/7193013-creative-technical-requirements) .*


### **Creative Tips for Roku Advertising**


On Roku, clarity wins. Get to the product or offer quickly, use large on-screen text, and make the brand, message, and CTA easy to understand from across the room. Creative should be simple, direct, and designed for the big screen (not resized from a mobile feed).


For interactive formats such as Action Ads, give viewers a single clear next step. The interactive layer should make the response easier, not add another message they have to process.


---


## **Peacock**


Peacock stands out with its mix of live sports, current NBCUniversal programming, blockbuster films, original series, and familiar franchises. That breadth of content alone, not even just the size of the brand behind it, makes it a strong addition to any CTV advertising campaign.


### **Peacock **Ad Formats & Video Specs****


Aspect ratio


16:9 HD (1920 × 1080 for mezzanine files; 1920 × 1080 or 1280 × 720 for high renditions)


Max file size


10 GB


Video length


Pre-roll: 6, 15, or 30 seconds; mid-roll: 15, 30, 45, or 60 seconds; 90 seconds available for Peacock upon request


Frame rate


23.98, 24, 25, 29.97, or 30 FPS; constant, native frame rate and progressive scan


Bitrate


10–30 Mbps for mezzanine files


File type


.mp4 or .mov for mezzanine files; .mp4 for high, medium, and low renditions


*See the full list of[Peacock Creative Specifications](https://nbcu-data-collaboration.scrollhelp.site/nbcdc/nbcu-programmatic-video-guidelines) .*


### **Creative Tips for Peacock Advertising**


On Peacock, advertisers that win play into event energy. Lead with a bold opening, keep the pacing tight, and make the product, offer, and CTA easy to follow. Creative can carry personality and drama, as long as the payoff lands quickly.


Sports, reality programming, and live cultural moments create an energetic viewing environment. Use this to your advantage and make sure your ad blends in with the programming. Use motion, sound, and concise storytelling strategically to meet the moment without overwhelming viewers.

## **Paramount+**


Paramount+ combines live sports, original series, hit movies, CBS programming, and SHOWTIME content. This broad spectrum of content gives advertisers access to quite a diverse crowd of streamers. Regardless of what your brand offers, your audience is most likely watching something on Paramount+.


### **Paramount+ **Ad Formats & Video Specs****


Aspect ratio


16:9 (1280 × 720 minimum, with no black bars)


Max file size


10 GB


Video length


15 or 30 seconds


Frame rate


23.98/23.976, 24, 25, 29.97, or 30 FPS; constant, native frame rate and progressive scan


Bitrate


6 Mbps minimum


File type


.mp4 with H.264 High Profile preferred; .mov with Apple ProRes 422 or ProRes 422 HQ accepted


*See the full list of[Paramount+ Creative Specifications](https://adsmanager.paramount.com/resources/tech-specs) .*


### **Creative Tips for Paramount+ Advertising**


Paramount+ is built around major franchises, live sports, and passionate fan communities. Make your creative feel worthy of the big screen. In other words, if your ad feels like a local mattress firm commercial, you’ll need to go back to the drawing board.


Start with a bold visual or a compelling headline, and keep the spot focused on one message (a primary theme of today’s article). Use motion and audio together so the message still lands even when viewers are multitasking. Lastly, give the brand and CTA enough screen time so they register with your viewers. This is one aspect where repetition helps, not hurts.

## **HBO Max**


HBO Max delivers premium original series, blockbuster movies, documentaries, major franchises, and live sports. A large, trusted name in the television space, like HBO, means high-quality CTV inventory in an environment where viewers expect polished storytelling. Build your ad right and let HBO’s ad platform do the rest.


### **HBO Max **Ad Formats & Video Specs****


Aspect ratio


16:9 (1920 × 1080)


Max file size


1 GB


Video length


15, 30, 45, or 60 seconds


Frame rate


23.98 or 29.97 FPS; constant frame rate and progressive scan


Bitrate


15 Mbps minimum


File type


.mp4 preferred or .mov accepted, using H.264, Apple ProRes 422, or Apple ProRes 422 HQ


*See the full list of[HBO Max Creative Specifications](https://www.wbdadspecs.com/ad-specs/) .*


### **Creative Tips for HBO Max Advertising**


Resist the urge to oversell. Polished cinematography, focused storytelling, and a little restraint will feel more at home alongside HBO Max’s premium programming than a spot trying to explain everything at once.


Build the commercial around one strong idea, give the visuals room to breathe, and make the final brand and CTA moment clear without breaking the story’s tone. To put it another way, your ad needs to be like a chameleon, matching the surrounding content. While that may sound counterintuitive, it’s important that your ad feels like a natural part of the programming rather than a random interruption.

## **Amazon Prime Video**


Amazon is more than just an e-commerce destination. It’s an entertainment hub, too. Prime Video delivers global reach through its mix of original and licensed shows, movies, and live entertainment. Its supported ad lengths vary by country, so marketers should select their markets before finalizing production.


### **Amazon **Ad Formats & Video Specs****


Aspect ratio


16:9 (1920 × 1080 minimum)


Max file size


500 MB


Video length


15, 30, 45, or 60 seconds in the United States and Canada; supported lengths vary by country


Frame rate


23.976 FPS recommended; 24, 25, and 29.97 FPS also accepted; constant frame rate


Bitrate


15 Mbps minimum and 50 Mbps recommended for Prime Video campaigns


File type


.mp4 required for site-served creative; supported video codecs include H.264, MPEG-2, and MPEG-4


*See the full list of[Prime Video Creative Specifications](https://advertising.amazon.com/resources/ad-specs/dsp/video/streaming-tv-prime-video-ads) .*


### **Creative Tips for Prime Video** **Advertising**


Prime Video viewers are immersed in shows, movies, and live entertainment. A message that’s applicable to other major streaming services is also applicable here: make your ad feel like a natural extension of the big-screen experience.


Standard non-interactive Prime Video ads run in non-clickable environments. Avoid button-shaped CTAs or language that implies viewers can click the commercial. Instead, use a memorable URL, verbal instruction, or another next step that makes sense from the living-room screen.

## **YouTube** TV


YouTube TV (not to be confused with YouTube Premium) is a paid streaming service that brings a traditional linear TV-style experience to your Connected TV device. Ads can reach YouTube TV through reservation buys and eligible broader YouTube campaigns.


### **YouTube **Ad Formats & Video Specs****


Aspect ratio


16:9 horizontal for CTV (1920 × 1080 recommended; 1280 × 720 minimum for HD)


Max file size


256 GB


Video length


Bumpers are 6 seconds or shorter; non-skippable ads are 15 seconds or shorter, 30 seconds, or 60 seconds; 30- and 60-second ads must be within one second of the expected duration; skippable reservation ads run from 12 seconds to 6 minutes and can be skipped after five seconds


Frame rate


Match the native frame rate of the source footage; common rates include 24, 25, 30, 48, 50, and 60 FPS; progressive scan


Bitrate


For 1080p SDR, 8 Mbps is recommended at 24, 25, or 30 FPS and 12 Mbps at 48, 50, or 60 FPS


File type


.mp4 with H.264 video and AAC-LC audio recommended; Google accepts several additional YouTube-supported video formats


*See the full list of[YouTube TV Creative Specifications](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/14442864) .*


### **Creative Tips for YouTube TV Advertising**


YouTube TV viewers are watching live and on-demand programming on their TVs, so it’s important not to build for the mobile feed. Lead with a clear value proposition, introduce the brand early, and keep on-screen text large and readable.


For skippable placements, the first five seconds have one job: earn the next five. For non-skippable ads, use the fixed duration to deliver one complete, memorable message without trying to squeeze in every possible benefit.
